items_flat.title_en: Astra is live for Pro/Enterprise seats, API, Azure Foundry and GitHub Copilot; Plus still queued
items_flat.title_zh: Astra 已對 Pro／企業席次、API、Azure Foundry 與 GitHub Copilot 上線；Plus 仍排隊
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI said GPT-6 Astra is now available to all Pro, Enterprise, and Business Premium users in ChatGPT Work and Codex, and is live in the API; Plus and remaining Business seats will follow over a few days. Microsoft said Astra is generally available in Microsoft Foundry. GitHub separately listed Astra as generally available in Copilot for Pro+, Max, Business and Enterprise, with a gradual rollout.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 表示 GPT-6 Astra 已對所有 Pro、Enterprise 與 Business Premium 用戶在 ChatGPT Work 與 Codex 開放，並已上線 API；Plus 與其餘 Business 席次將於數日內跟進。Microsoft 稱 Astra 已在 Microsoft Foundry 正式提供。GitHub 則將 Astra 列為 Copilot Pro+、Max、Business 與 Enterprise 一般可用，採逐步開通。
items_flat.analysis_en: The story has moved from launch claims to who can actually select the model. Highest-paying ChatGPT seats and cloud/IDE channels flipped first; Plus access and quota tightness remain the binding constraint.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 焦點已從「宣布推出」轉成「誰能真正選到模型」。高價 ChatGPT 席次與雲端／IDE 通路先開；Plus 開通時程與配額仍是瓶頸。
items_flat.quote: GPT-6 Astra is now available to all Pro, Enterprise, and Business Premium users in Work/Codex, and is available in the API. We will start rollout to Plus and Business users next.
items_flat.quote_zh: GPT-6 Astra 現已對所有 Pro、Enterprise 與 Business Premium 用戶在 Work／Codex 開放，並已上線 API。接下來將開始向 Plus 與 Business 用戶推送。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic: Claude produced the first Lean formalization of Fermat’s Last Theorem
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic：Claude 完成費馬大定理首個 Lean 形式化證明
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic said Claude, working largely autonomously over 11 days, wrote the first end-to-end computer-checked Lean proof of Fermat’s Last Theorem—about 13 million lines covering more than 29,000 intermediate theorems. The company published the research post, GitHub repo, and Kevin Buzzard’s review that the statement matches Mathlib and uses only Lean’s three standard axioms.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 表示 Claude 在約 11 天內大致自主寫出費馬大定理首份端到端、可被電腦檢查的 Lean 證明，約 1,300 萬行、涵蓋逾 2.9 萬條中間定理。公司公布研究文、GitHub 倉庫，以及 Kevin Buzzard 的審閱：定理陳述與 Mathlib 一致，且僅使用 Lean 三條標準公理。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a verification milestone, not a new human proof of FLT. What changes is the demonstrated scale of AI-written Lean libraries; what remains uncertain is how much human scaffolding and platform design (Prove2Me) were required for the run to succeed.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是驗證里程碑，不是費馬大定理的新人類證明。改變的是 AI 撰寫 Lean 庫的規模已被展示；仍不確定的是人類高層指令與 Prove2Me 平台對成功佔多大比重。
items_flat.quote: In 11 days, working largely autonomously, Claude produced the first end-to-end, computer-checked proof of FLT. Along the way, it wrote 13 million lines of Lean and proved 29,500 intermediate theorems.
items_flat.quote_zh: 在 11 天內，Claude 大致自主完成費馬大定理首份端到端、可被電腦檢查的證明。過程中寫了 1,300 萬行 Lean，並證明 29,500 條中間定理。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI banks daily Astra resets for paid users still locked out
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 為尚未開通 Astra 的付費用戶累積每日重置
items_flat.summary_en: ChatGPT/Codex lead Tibo said OpenAI will bank one reset for every day a paid ChatGPT plan lacks Astra access, with the first credit landing about three hours after the Sept. 3 post. OpenAI’s help center now documents banked Codex resets for existing Plus, Pro and Business users on Sept. 3 and 4, and eligibility windows for new accounts.
items_flat.summary_zh: ChatGPT／Codex 負責人 Tibo 表示，付費方案若當日尚未開通 Astra，OpenAI 會累積一次重置，首筆約在 9 月 3 日貼文後三小時入帳。官方說明中心現已記載既有 Plus、Pro、Business 用戶在 9 月 3、4 日可獲累積重置，以及新帳號的資格時窗。
items_flat.analysis_en: Compensating unused days is an admission that demand outran serving capacity. Credits do not by themselves confirm when remaining Plus seats flip on.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 補償未開通天數等於承認需求超過供應。累積重置本身並不能證明剩餘 Plus 席次何時開通。
items_flat.quote: We will give one banked reset for every day you don't have access to Astra on your paid ChatGPT plan, starting today.
items_flat.quote_zh: 自即日起，只要你的付費 ChatGPT 方案當天還沒有 Astra，我們就會給你一次累積重置。

items_flat.title_en: xAI expands Grok Bot: enterprise access, marketplace templates, iPad
items_flat.title_zh: xAI 擴大 Grok Bot：企業開通、模板市集與 iPad
items_flat.summary_en: xAI’s Grok Bot for Enterprise page says Grok and Cursor Enterprise customers get free usage for two weeks and can invite the whole organization. Official product copy added access, network and audit controls so organizations can govern always-on cloud Bots at scale.
items_flat.summary_zh: xAI「Grok Bot for Enterprise」頁面寫明：Grok 與 Cursor Enterprise 客戶可享兩週免費用量，並可邀請整個組織。官方產品說明新增存取、網路與稽核控制，讓企業能大規模治理全天候雲端 Bot。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a distribution and workflow release, not a new Grok foundation model. The two-week free window and admin controls matter more for adoption than any unpublished model bump.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是通路與工作流發布，不是新的 Grok 基礎模型。兩週免費窗與管理控制對採用的影響，大於未公布的模型小幅升級。
items_flat.quote: Grok and Cursor Enterprise customers have free usage for the next two weeks, and can invite their whole organization, including people without an existing seat.
items_flat.quote_zh: Grok 與 Cursor Enterprise 客戶未來兩週可免費使用，並可邀請整個組織，包括尚無席次的成員。

items_flat.title_en: Meta enables Muse Spark 1.3 max reasoning on Muse Code and Meta Model API
items_flat.title_zh: Meta 在 Muse Code 與 Meta Model API 開放 Muse Spark 1.3 max 推理
items_flat.summary_en: Meta CAIO Alexandr Wang said Muse Spark 1.3 max is now publicly released, with stronger coding and agentic results than the high and xhigh settings. @AIatMeta confirmed max reasoning is available on Muse Code and the Meta Model API. Wang followed up that users should try max even after testing high/xhigh.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta 首席 AI 官 Alexandr Wang 表示 Muse Spark 1.3 max 已公開釋出，編碼與代理表現優於 high／xhigh。@AIatMeta 確認 max 推理已可在 Muse Code 與 Meta Model API 使用。Wang 後續仍建議即使試過 high／xhigh 也應再試 max。
items_flat.analysis_en: This completes a flagship setting that Meta had held back for extra safety testing. Independent scores for the callable max tier, not the launch video, will decide whether 1.3 changes buyer rankings.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這補齊 Meta 先前因額外安全測試而暫緩的旗艦設定。能實際呼叫的 max 檔獨立分數，而非發表影片，才會決定 1.3 是否改寫採購排名。
items_flat.quote: we just publicly released Muse Spark 1.3 max! we see significantly stronger coding and agentic performance on muse spark 1.3 max
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們剛公開釋出 Muse Spark 1.3 max！在編碼與代理任務上，max 明顯強於其他檔位。
